title: UI风格#39 - Dystopian Tech (反乌托邦科技)
description: 创建第39种UI风格：反乌托邦科技风格 - 铁锈工业、监控色调、压抑氛围。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planAM.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Dystopian Tech style When color palette Then features rust browns, warning yellows, cold grays, surveillance reds
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#8B4513 (铁锈), #FFD700 (警告黄), #2F2F2F (冷灰), #8B0000 (监控红), #0D0D0D (炭黑)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Dystopian Tech style When typography Then uses industrial fonts: Share Tech Mono, Oswald, or Roboto Mono
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Share Tech Mono (显示), Oswald (正文), Roboto Mono (代码)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Dystopian Tech style When layout Then industrial grids, warning stripes, exposed infrastructure
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：工业网格、警示条纹、暴露基础设施、压抑空间

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Dystopian Tech style When UI elements Then rusted borders, warning labels, surveillance markers
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：锈蚀边框、警告标签、监控标记、禁入符号

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Dystopian Tech UI When functional Then includes surveillance chat, control agents, threat stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：监控聊天、控制代理、威胁统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Dystopian Tech UI When copy Then uses authoritarian: 'Control', 'Surveillance', 'Compliance', 'Order'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'CONTROL. SURVEILLANCE. ORDER.'、按钮'SEND'→'REPORT'、'SUBMIT'→'COMPLY'
